description: 統計いしがき】警察、消防および災害 [fire, police and emergency services and disaster risk and hazard maps] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 石垣市. 11-1. 刑法犯罪種別発生状況と身近な犯罪発生状況 11-2. 交通事故発生状況 11-3. 月別出火件数 11-4. 種類別火災件数 11-5. 原因別火災件数 11-6. 出火時刻別火災件数 11-7. 火災発生件数、出動車両、出動人員、損害額の推移 11-8. 事故種別救急出動回数 11-9. 消防署職員および消防団員数の推移 1... Coverage: 石垣市. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 石垣市. Its tags are 令和6年度統計いしがき. It offers 13 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-05-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
